result.description: Open-source Postgres backend platform (database, auth, storage, edge functions, realtime) with a Management API for managing projects and orgs.
result.auth_detail: Management API: personal access token (bearer) for own account, or OAuth2 auth-code for third-party integrations (access+refresh tokens). Per-project data APIs use project anon/service_role API keys or user JWTs.
result.access_detail: Anyone can sign up free, generate PATs, and register OAuth apps in org settings. Management API has no plan-tier restriction; resources created are billed per pricing. Rate limit 120 req/min.
result.api_notes: Management API (api.supabase.com) covers projects, orgs, branches, secrets, edge functions, database config, SQL query, auth config etc. Plus per-project PostgREST auto-generated REST, Auth (GoTrue), Storage, Edge Functions APIs.

evidence.quote: PATs are tokens with a custom expiry that you manually generate to access the Management API.
This guide steps through building a Supabase Integration using OAuth2 and the management API,
All resources created via the API are subject to the pricing detailed on our Pricing pages.
All API requests require an access token to be included in the Authorization header:
The hosted Supabase MCP server is available at `https://mcp.supabase.com/mcp`.
